rules.unit: unique simulator calls; a repeated design is free
rules.primary_statistic: restricted mean evaluations to target, every run capped at the budget
rules.secondary_statistic: median evaluations; a method miss counts as never reaching the target
rules.baseline_miss: counted at the budget, so the true speed-up can only be larger
rules.invalid_runs: any run that bypassed the counter blocks the comparison
